'''Plo Koon's lightsaber''' was the lightsaber constructed and used by the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] during the decades leading up to his death in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].

==History==
[[File:PloKoon-SWFB.png|left|thumb|Plo Koon wielding his lightsaber]]
When [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] called out for all available [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to accompany him to Geonosis to help [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Koon and a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|strike team]] of fellow Jedi traveled to Geonosis, carrying it into battle against the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]].<ref name="Ep. II" />

Koon continued to wield it as he became a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="RM">{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref> until his death during [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] in the skies of Cato Neimoidia.<ref name="Ep. III">{{Film|III}}</ref> He wielded the weapon on numerous fronts ranging from the orbit of [[Anza/Legends|Anza]], [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]]. It isn't known, however, what led (story-wise) the crystal change from orange to blue.

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This lightsaber hilt is a copy of [[Mace Windu's blue-bladed lightsaber|the one]] carried by [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] in promotional material for [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]<ref name="TPMCVD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and of [[Luminara's lightsaber/Legends|Luminara's lightsaber]],<ref name="Ep. II" /> with the addition of [[Color/Legends|blue coloring]] of the grooves around its [[Blade emitter/Legends|blade emitter]].<ref name="AOTCVD" /> Both Plo Koon's and Mace Windu's copies were blue bladed, while Luminara's one was green bladed. Both Koon and Unduli's lightsabers had colored grooves towards the emitter, and Luminara had a colored pommel as well, while Mace Windu's lightsaber was plain.
